selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This is the method-type anchor because the only quantity identifiable under the retry's narrow scope is the effect of one paper operator on one already locked user task after that trial's own costs and regressions. The reframe_as_solvable_object move turns diffuse paper value into a causal per-operator responsibility object on a fixed task, with faithfulness certified by an interface-matched intervention rather than by extrapolation.

selected_gaps.gap: Under a limited initial budget, no retrieved frontier establishes that the observed low-fidelity score preserves the sign and ordering of paper interventions by the performance improvement they later produce on independently specified user tasks; a probe can therefore support the wrong go/no-go decision even when it is internally faithful.
